description: React component for scheduled post actions in Mattermost, including editing, deleting, rescheduling, copying, and sending scheduled posts with modal dialogs and permissions handling.

classes.name: ScheduledPostActions
classes.description: React functional component providing action buttons for scheduled posts, with permissions and state management.

methods.name: ScheduledPostActions
methods.description: Main React component rendering action buttons for scheduled posts, handling modal dialogs and permissions.

methods.name: handleReschedulePost
methods.description: Opens modal to reschedule the post.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Opens modal to confirm deletion of the scheduled post.

methods.name: handleSend
methods.description: Opens modal to send the scheduled post immediately.
